items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Lucky Thompson was there on tenor. We had a lot of fun.

ctx.x: So when I left the band and when Hamp came back to New York, this is why he wanted me to come back.
He say, "I need an alto player. Come and play (inaudible) for a couple of weeks." I say, "Okay."
